name: io.github.parisbs/codex-subagent-mcp
title: Codex Subagent
description: Delegate coding tasks to the OpenAI Codex CLI, installed separately, with explicit model and effort.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used when a call names none; without it the server asks which model to use.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MCP_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_PLUGINS
environmentVariables.description: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Codex executable, if it is not codex on PATH. On Windows it must be codex.exe, not a .cmd shim.
